integrity: An analytic exact common-age covariance identity, finite-N Gaussian order-moment integrations, and joint Gaussian Gumbel limit with fourth-moment control prove the statement. A deterministic numerical checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Stationary one-dimensional independent Brownian particles under a single complete Poisson reset clock; no monotonicity asserted in population size, no partial-reset/independent-reset/renewal generalization. The negative-to-positive statement proves N=4 first, not positivity for all N>=4. Independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp bilateral-front synchronization and a four-particle sign reversal in a reset Brownian gas
